description: Photos, numbers and colour as rounded tiles in one image, like the site’s Bento. Templates and their tiles in reading order (left to right, top to bottom): mosaic-5 (photo (big), photo, text "+38%", photo, photo (big)); hero-2 (photo (big), photo, text "10k"); hero-left-4 (photo (big), photo, text "4.9", colour, photo); three-cols (photo, photo, photo); big-strip (photo (big), photo, text "2026", photo); six-even (photo, photo, photo, photo, photo, photo); stat-board (text "Q3 in numbers", photo, text "2.4M", text "38%", text "120"); feature-3 (photo (big), text "10k", text "98%", text "24/7"); case-cover (text "Case study", photo (big), colour, photo). Give photos to fill the photo tiles in order, and optionally tiles to replace each slot in that same order (a photo, a text tile, or a plain colour); slots you don't replace keep the template’s own. Saved as bento-<template>.png in ~/Downloads/one-design.

canvas.description: square 1080×1080, portrait 1080×1350, story 1080×1920, landscape 1920×1080, x 1600×900 (X / LinkedIn post), slide 3840×2160, or custom.

padding.description: Space around the grid in px.

photos.description: Photos for the photo tiles, in order (files or a folder).

template.description: The grid template (see the description for its tiles).

text_colour.description: Text colour for every text tile, hex. Default: each tile’s own.

tiles.description: Replaces the template’s tiles in reading order: the first entry is the first tile, and so on.

file.description: The photo. Without one, photo tiles take the photos list in order.

focus_x.description: Where the crop sits across, 0 (left) to 100 (right). Default: the most interesting part.

focus_y.description: Where the crop sits down, 0 (top) to 100 (bottom).

big_number.description: A number or short text set large, e.g. "+38%" or "10k".

caption.description: The small caption at the bottom.

ink.description: Text colour, hex. Default: white or near black, whichever reads on the fill.

size.description: How big the big line is (it shrinks to fit). Default L.

title.description: The big line (a headline), or with big_number, a small line under it.
